credits.title: Space Boys
credits.overview: A young alien flees his home planet, Paliaaq, in search of a life far from the conservative constraints that have shaped his existence since birth. On Earth, he meets two humans who lead him straight into a collision of pleasures he has never before experienced.

credits.title: MANIA
credits.overview: On an ordinary day, Alana is the last girl chosen in her PE class. In the afternoon, she goes to the house of a distant classmate, with no intention of making friends. While they build a model, smoke and even kiss, Alana observes the family up close and finally comes face to face with Clarissa.
